title: The Last Passage for the Bronze
original_pitch: Inside a mold for a bronze horse, molten metal advances through the cavity the wax left behind. A tiny pocket of air retreats ahead of it. At the horseâ€™s highest ear the air finds its vent, an instant before the two metal fronts close the passage.
selection_justification: An illuminated cutaway turns casting into an interior chase between molten metal and the last trapped air pocket.
adaptation: Inside a stylized horse-shaped mold, luminous bronze rises behind a trapped air pocket. The bubble climbs the neck and escapes through the ear vent before the fill reaches the top. The mold retreats to reveal the bronze horse.
story_beats: 0–4 s: dark horse mold and first molten entry
4–9 s: bronze climbs the cavity behind the air
9–11 s: bubble escapes through the ear vent
11–14 s: the complete bronze horse emerges
music_prompt: Fourteen second instrumental foundry suspense. Low modular pulse, bowed metal, contrabass, rising strings. Heat and pressure build to eleven seconds, then one bright released overtone and a noble bronze chord. No vocals or speech.
sfx_prompt: Hot metal flowing and soft furnace roar, increasing pressure, then a short clean air release through a small vent and a resonant cooling metal tick. No music or speech.
